NothingOpen: Nothing is open. Apps you open show here.
OpenInOwnWindow: Open in a window of its own
ScreenSizeHint: What the app is told its screen is.
NotRespondingBody: {app} isn't responding. You can wait, or end it at once.
SampleSurface: Sample: no runtime is connected, so nothing runs. This is where the app will draw.
FailedNativeDisabled: This app needs its arm64 native code to start, and native code is currently off for it.
FailedNative: Its native code asked for something Windows-ARM64.apk doesn't provide yet, so the app was stopped before it could misbehave.
FailedGraphics: It needs graphics this PC can't give apps yet, so it was stopped.
FailedUnsupported: This app is built in a way Windows-ARM64.apk can't run.
FailedMissing: Something it needs to run is missing on this PC. Diagnostics shows what.
FailedOther: Something went wrong while it started. Diagnostics shows its log.
FailedSafe: Nothing on your PC changed, and the app's data is as it was.
TryNativeOff: Try it with native code off?
TryNativeOffHint: Only its Java code would run. Parts that need native code, like the drawing, may not appear.
TryNativeRestricted: Allow restricted native code for this app?
TryNativeRestrictedHint: Experimental. Enables its arm64 native libraries and GPU rendering within profile N2.
BackToMainHint: As a pane — it keeps running
HomeFoot: Each app runs in a process of its own: if one stops, the others keep going. Right-click an app for more.
EmptyBody: Drop an .apk file here, or choose one. Windows-ARM64.apk reads it first and tells you what will work on this PC. Nothing in it runs until you open it.
RunsToday: What runs on this PC today
TodayJava: Apps written in Java or Kotlin
TodayJavaHint: Converted to run on an ARM64 Java runtime on Windows.
TodayNativeHint: Off by default. You can allow a restricted, tested set per app.
TodayGLESHint: Drawn through Direct3D 11 or Vulkan on this PC.
TodayVulkanHint: This PC's driver may have Vulkan, but apps can't use it yet.
TrustNote: Apps run with your Windows account's access. Add only APKs you trust.
SeeFullCheck: See the full check of this PC
OpenNeedsJava: Open works as soon as the Java runtime is ready.
OpenInWindow: Open in a window of its own
LineNeedsVulkan: Needs Vulkan for apps, not here yet
OpensInWindow: Opens in a window of its own
JavaCardTitle: Get the Java runtime to run apps
JavaCardBody: Windows-ARM64.apk runs apps on an ARM64 Java runtime and didn't find one. It can get its own, OpenJDK 21 for ARM64, in its own folder. It doesn't change Java elsewhere on your PC, the PATH or any other setting.
JavaFailed: The Java runtime couldn't be installed. Nothing was changed.
StepInstall: Putting it in its own folder
StepTest: Making sure it runs as ARM64
StepCheckHint: Its checksum and signature must match before anything is unpacked.
StepInstallTitle: Put it in its own folder
StepTestTitle: Make sure it runs as ARM64
JavaPrivate: Only Windows-ARM64.apk uses this Java runtime. It doesn't change Java elsewhere on your PC, the PATH or your environment, and needs no administrator rights. Settings › Runtime updates it.
ReadFailed: {file} couldn't be read as an Android app.
VerdictCanRunBody: Everything this app needs works on this PC.
VerdictJavaOnlyBody: This app includes native code. Native code support is experimental and off, so the parts of the app that need it won't start. After adding it, you can allow restricted native code in the app's settings.
VerdictNotYetBody: It needs Vulkan graphics for apps, which isn't available yet.
VerdictUnsupportedBody: Its native code is only for 32-bit ARM or x86, which never runs here.
FeatJavaHint: Converted when the app first opens. This takes a moment once.
FeatNativeHint: {count, plural, one {# library.} other {# libraries.}} Only arm64 code could ever run here; 32-bit code never does.
FeatGLESHint: Drawn through Direct3D 11 or Vulkan on this PC.
FeatVulkanHint: Apps' own Vulkan calls aren't bridged yet.
AlreadyAdded: This app is in the library already. Adding it replaces that one and keeps its settings.
InOwnWindow: In a window of its own
NothingRan: Nothing in this file has run. It was only read.
LastFailed: Last opened, it stopped while starting.
OpensHint: Open does this; its arrow offers the other ways once.
AppDataHint: In a folder of its own.
NativeCodeHint: Off: only the app's Java code runs. Restricted: its arm64 native code runs within the profile below, and the app stops with a message if it needs anything outside it. Experimental, and never a sandbox.
ProfileN0Hint: Libraries that call nothing outside themselves, such as maths or decoding.
ProfileN1: N1 · C library and Java calls
ProfileN1Hint: Also the standard C library, threads, and calls to and from the app's Java code.
ProfileN2Hint: Also drawing with OpenGL ES from native code.
GraphicsHint: Automatic uses Vulkan on this PC, else Direct3D 11. A choice of one is kept: when it isn't available, the app says so instead of switching.
ChangesNextOpen: Changes apply the next time the app opens.
CloseBody: Apps open as panes stop when the main window closes:
CloseHint: Each one is asked to close, as Stop does. To keep one running, open it in a window of its own first.
StopAndClose: {count, plural, one {Stop # app and close} other {Stop # apps and close}}
RemoveBody: It stops if it's open, leaves the library, and deletes the APK copy saved by Windows-ARM64.apk. Your original APK file stays where it is.
GeneralAbout: How apps open, where their data lives, and how Windows-ARM64.apk looks.
RuntimeAbout: What apps run on. Changes apply to each app the next time it opens.
AboutAbout: Runs selected Android apps as native Windows apps on ARM64 PCs.
NewAppsOpenHint: Each app can change this in its details. The arrow beside Open offers the other ways once.
WhenClosing: When you close the main window
WhenClosingHint: Apps open as panes always stop with it.
KeepWindowsRunning: Keep apps in windows of their own running
AskFirst: Ask first when apps would stop
AskFirstHint: Lists the apps open as panes before the window closes.
AppDataSettingHint: Each app keeps what it saves in a folder of its own here. Moving it needs every app stopped.
LanguageHint: For Windows-ARM64.apk itself. Apps choose their own.
AppearanceHint: Light, dark, or the same as Windows.
JavaUseHint: An ARM64 Java runtime, version 21 or later.
JavaOwnHint: Installed by Windows-ARM64.apk in its own folder. Only it uses this runtime: Java elsewhere on your PC, the PATH and your environment are left alone.
KeepUpdatedHint: Installs new OpenJDK 21 updates for this runtime by itself, checked like the first download, when no app is running. Windows-ARM64.apk itself never updates on its own.
NewAppsNativeOff: New apps start with native code off
NewAppsNativeOffHint: Restricted native code is allowed one app at a time, in its details.
DefaultProfileHint: N0: self-contained code only. N1: also the C library, threads and Java calls. N2: also OpenGL ES drawing.
SupportsNow: What this PC supports right now is in
BasedOnHint: Uses Mac.apk's conversion of app code, its Android framework and its reading of APKs. Windows-ARM64.apk isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Mac.apk or its authors.
SourceCodeHint: Open to everyone who uses it, as its license requires.
LicenseHint: AGPL-3.0, the license of Windows-ARM64.apk and of Mac.apk.
NoticesHint: OpenJDK, ANGLE, the Vulkan loader and the other parts it includes.
NoAutoUpdatesHint: Windows-ARM64.apk doesn't check for or install updates, and never makes itself the app that opens .apk files. New versions are on the releases page.
DemoBanner: Sample data: the runtime isn't connected yet, so nothing here was checked on this PC.
HeadReady: Apps written in Java or Kotlin can run on this PC
HeadNotReady: Apps can't run on this PC yet
CantRunYetTitle: What this PC can't run yet
Cant32: Native code for 32-bit ARM, x86 or x86-64
CantDevices: Camera, microphone, location, sensors and WebView
CantOutside: Native code outside profiles N0 – N2
CantSandbox: Each app has its own process for crash handling; that isn't a security sandbox
NoLogs: No app has run since Windows-ARM64.apk started. Apps' logs show here once they open.
LogsPrivate: Logs stay on this PC. They leave out your apps' data, passwords and tokens, and the full environment.
DragHint: Drag onto another pane to split, onto the sidebar to give it a place of its own, or out of the window to open it in a window of its own
AsksForHint: {perms}. Windows-ARM64.apk doesn't ask you about these; the app gets what your account can do.
PermOther: {count, plural, one {# other permission} other {# other permissions}}
DiagHeadSub: Native code: a restricted set is available, experimental and off by default. Vulkan for apps: not available yet.
ConvertedCodeHint: Made the first time each app opens, so later starts are quicker. {size}. Anything cleared is made again when needed.
AppDataTotalHint: Each app keeps what it saves in a folder of its own here. {size} in all. Moving it needs every app stopped.
JavaInstalledOn: Installed by Windows-ARM64.apk on {date}, in its own folder. Only it uses this runtime: Java elsewhere on your PC, the PATH and your environment are left alone.
NativeNoticeBody: Experimental. If the app needs anything outside {profile}, it stops with a clear message.
OtherAppsRunning: Your other apps kept running. Close this pane with ×.
SignedUpdatesHint: Checks GitHub Releases for a newer Windows-ARM64.apk build signed with the project's Ed25519 update key.
VulkanTranslatedNote: This PC has no native GPU Vulkan driver — Vulkan runs through Windows' Dozen translation layer (OpenGL ES 2.0 only). Automatic or Direct3D 11 uses native hardware OpenGL ES 3.0 and is recommended for Flutter and 3D apps.
RemoveKeepDataHint: Keeps this app's saved data on your PC. Reinstalling the same APK later brings your data back.
RemoveDeleteData: Delete APK and all app data
RemoveDeleteDataHint: Also permanently deletes this app's saved data ({size}) and converted code. This can't be undone.
RemoveDeleteDataHintEmpty: Also permanently deletes any saved data and converted code for this app. This can't be undone.
